problem_statement: Return True if values is sorted in non-decreasing order (each element is less than or equal to the next), otherwise False. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. An empty list and a single-element list are sorted. Do not modify the input.

bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses >= instead of >, rejecting lists with equal adjacent elements that are still sorted in non-decreasing order.
